entities.summary: Fakhruddin G. Ebrahim, TI was a Pakistani retired judge, legal expert and senior most lawyer. He was appointed as the 24th Chief Election Commissioner of Pakistan on 14 July 2012 and served until he resigned on 31 July 2013 and oversaw the 2013 election.
